BR-38
Bl'IAKE - HEAR !3f1AKE CALIPER
DISASSEMBLY
1. REMOVE SET RING AND CYLINDER BOOT
Using a screwdriver, remove the set ring and cylinder boot.
2. REMOVE PISTON
(a) Put a piece of cloth or an equivalent between the piston
and caliper,
(b) Use compressed air to remove the piston from the cylin-
der.
CAUTION:
Do not place your fingers in front of the piston when using
compressed air.
N
3. REMOVE PISTON SEAL FROM CYLINDER
Using a screwdriver, remove the piston seal.
4. REMOVE 2 SLIDING BUSHINGS ANO 3 DUST BOOTS
N
